responsibility: Implements the OpenRISC backend’s procedural target hooks and expander helpers that cannot be expressed in the machine description alone. This file owns per-function frame-layout state, prologue/epilogue and register-save logic, calling-convention helpers for argument passing and return values, address legitimacy and operand/assembly printing support, trampoline and thunk emission, and target-specific expansion for operations such as atomics and exception-return-related saves. It consumes GCC RTL, function ABI state, and target option flags and produces OpenRISC-specific RTL sequences, assembler output, and hook decisions wired into targetm for the rest of the backend.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem or1k files, this is the executable backend implementation file: it defines OpenRISC target hooks and helper routines in C, such as frame-layout/prologue logic, calling-convention helpers, atomic expanders, operand printing, and thunk emission, and binds them through targetm. Unlike or1k.h it declares no target macros, unlike or1k.md it is not the declarative RTL instruction-pattern file, and unlike or1k.opt it does not define command-line options.
